stepNotes.1: The generated declaration exposes AdvisoryLock, IndexStore, IntervalTree, and three free functions; package metadata points types to index.d.ts and regeneration to the Rust crate.
stepNotes.2: Native boundaries include caller-selected lock, database, and hash-file paths; SQL values are parameterized and JSON writes deserialize before mutation, with no network or subprocess behavior.
stepNotes.3: Close consumes the optional SQLite connection and blocks reuse, while clear and ingest are transactional; ingest does not cross-check payload project/file identity against its explicit arguments.
stepNotes.4: Prepared transactional bulk writes and scoped pruning are efficient, but IntervalTree lookup scans the full pre-partition prefix and is worst-case linear despite its O(log n) description.
stepNotes.5: NAPI-RS owns declaration generation, Rust owns implementation, the centralized native loader owns availability, and NativeStore contains JSON/fallback adaptation for product callers.
stepNotes.6: Nullable and optional signatures match runtime behavior, release operations are idempotent, and malformed query-options JSON uniquely falls back to unfiltered options instead of rejecting.
stepNotes.7: Rust coverage spans 30 passing hash, ID, interval, lock, and SQLite tests; three adapter tests pass, with residual gaps around incoherent ingest payloads and malformed options.
stepNotes.8: The ledger and findings directory contain no accepted item; this pass found no Critical or High defect and retained three bounded robustness/performance follow-ups in the protocol narrative.
stepNotes.9: cargo test passed 30 tests, the targeted native-store Vitest file passed three tests, and the core TypeScript typecheck passed; no Critical-triggered reverify artifact is needed.
